title.narrative: Humanitarian food assistance and protection in Gogrial East and Gogrial West, South Sudan

description.narrative: The project will build up the gains made in the previous five years of the SPA project. During the last year of the project, a Market System Development (MSD) approach was introduced, supported by CAFOD internal funds (CGF). The programme strategy shall be centered on implementing a sustainable phase out plan in Yirol East with co-funding from internal sources. The previous activities in Gogrial East and West will transition to a market system-based approach and value as part of the exit sustainability strategy. The transition shall focus on 2 outcomes: (1) People facing acute food insecurity and malnutrition have their needs met in line with humanitarian principles and have reduced vulnerability and (2) People facing acute protection risks have improved safety and wellbeing in line with humanitarian principles. CTP conducted a market systems development and value chain analysis in the project target locations using its own sources of funds and shall use the outcome of the assessment and already initiated activities to scale up the approach for 12 months as part of the exit strategy.
